Subject: Edgeware — post-call recap & minimal kickoff checklist

Hi Samir / Anya,

Thanks again for taking the time today — good conversation. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we keep momentum while your security and procurement reviews run: 

Summary of what we covered
- Goal: Validate high-throughput semantic search on 100M document corpus; target 200ms p95 for query workloads and sub-$0.001/token average cost with batching/kv-cache optimizations.
- Current blocker: internal network egress rules + procurement timeline.

Minimal kickoff checklist (what we'd like to get from Edgeware to complete trial setup)
1) Network allowlist (shortlist of IPs and ports) — sample attached (network-whitelist-sample.txt).
2) Short PO / SOW confirmation or procurement contact (procurement@edgeware.ai is fine).
3) A primary technical point-of-contact for the 90-minute onboarding session (name + Slack/email).
4) Confirmation of data retention preferences and any specific encryption/KMS requirements.

What Redwood will do once we have the items above
- Stand up a dedicated trial sandbox with pinned model and quantization profile.
- Provide a 90-minute pairing session with one of our inference engineers to seed KV caching and a small sample workload.
- Share SOC2 / security evidence bundle and a short PCI/Sensitive Data note.

Attachments: edgeware-trial-checklist.pdf (1 page checklist), network-whitelist-sample.txt

Proposed next step: Are you available for a 90-min onboarding window next week (Oct 6 or Oct 7) 10:00–11:30 PT? If procurement needs an SOW or procurement-specific wording we can draft a minimal statement for signature.

If priority has shifted, say so and we can pause — otherwise I’ll follow up on Thursday with a one-line nudge.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
